title: Rethinking Pharmacy
subtitle: An interview with Elliot Cohen of PillPack
body_html:
This podcast is really good. PillPack, which was acquired by Amazon, was one of the early health tech companies that stuck the landing on consumer experience. Most founder interviews are a bit dull. This one is not! I loved this episode, and I hope you will too!

On an only tangentially related note, my book was turned into an audiobook by Amazon.

You can get it here. It’s about drugs! And yes, that is an affiliate link. I’ll do a version I narrate soon enough, I suspect.
